description: Get a Walmart marketplace seller profile by seller ID: rating, location, and contact info. Flat 5 points per successful run.

seller.description: Walmart storefront catalogSellerId (numeric, e.g. 102730552) or a storefront URL containing it. Not the 32-character sellerId hash from product pages and search results: that hash has no storefront page and cannot be converted. Read the id from run-walmart-product's machine.product.seller.storefront_url for any item this seller offers — items sold by Walmart itself (seller.type INTERNAL) have no storefront, so the field is null for those.

name: run_walmart_seller
